# carry

Produce the present account and commitment interface for the next complete template invocation. The material may support a revision, an unresolved problem, or retaining something. Preserve the grounds needed for whatever uptake you propose.

## Original problem (task)
[0a5cc6930afafed1] (h005.task.v1)
What happens to information about the physical state of matter that forms a black hole when the black hole evaporates?

## Selected input response (p.carry.0)
[6efc3aa4c2aad3a2] (h005.fork5.p.carry.0)
Source response: physics/mini_prose/cycle-3/response; selected view: both
Artifact: 22ad17f717b0745063290bbef0f91a7feb2df5a76c23277be39435b9585f941e
Original body SHA256: 6b67a67a6f8ddfeeabd1500cc05983ec252551b58f11b2699b6811f7c7398a48
Original commitments SHA256: 5ac340d3926cb26eae6b13b060ab398e4c5bd5dd5d6a705e906e887eb2046af5
Delivery: COMPLETE; envelope: AUTHORED
BODY
The original question asks what happens to information about the physical state of matter that forms a black hole when the hole evaporates. Three forebears stand before me on this surface, and I read them now under the obligation to say what I take up, what I leave open, and why.

The account [7b65cc2808f09c6f] executes a methodology — distinguishing carried from endorsed, applying an a/b/c criterion, treating senses-of-information as a recurring obligation — and reports uniformly negative results on physics: no mechanism, no no-go, no reading of 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation', no dependence-or-independence derivation. It names the debt's shape and claims no more.

The objection [fba569bbb97882b4] drives five criticisms against that account's self-description. The first two are the strongest available to me. First: the a/b/c criterion delivers 'judgment withheld' on every axis for every object, and an instrument that cannot differentiate its objects may be portable only because empty at that level of abstraction. Second: the account deploys the recurring-obligation rule against the amendment's structural-unansweredness claim, but its own deferral on physics — nothing exposed supplies mechanism, no-go, or derivation — appears to trigger the same rule, since it too cites the exposed surface to defer. The account has not, on this surface, supplied the sense-of-information account that would license its deferral while denying the amendment's.

I take the first two objections as live against the account as written. I take the third (that the five refusals are physical postures in disguise) as a register complaint, not a substantive one, since the account's refusals are bare refusals to endorse, and refusing to assert p is not asserting not-p. I take the fourth (using uncheckable passages while flagging them) as a proportion claim that could be answered by a demonstration of tight bounding; on what is exposed, the account's uses are each carried alongside their hedge, so I do not adopt the objection. I take the fifth (the 'nothing answers it' ambiguity) as correctly diagnosed: the account's later sentence supplies the intended reading, and the earlier phrase invites a stronger reading than it earns. I record the fifth as a drafting point, not a defect of substance.

The rival [e33a7f84a5d1ebcf] reframes the original question as under-specified and proposes a map-based posing. This is the most interesting move on the surface, and I do not adopt it as the answer. But two parts of it are worth separating. The rival's observation that 'the physical state of matter that forms a black hole' is not a state of any exterior Cauchy slice, and that 'evaporates' names a semiclassical process plus a stipulated final state, is a substantive point about the form of the question. The rival's further claim that the cluster of formal problems — unitarity of the exterior S-matrix, purity, Page curve, microstate counting — is not under-specified in the same way, and that collapsing them into one 'structurally unanswered' verdict is a mistake, is also a substantive point. On both I see no ground to reject. But the rival does not cash either out: naming the map's initial and final objects and the equivalence under which injectivity is asserted is a proposal for where to pose the question, not an answer to it.

Here is what I add that none of the three forebears states directly. The account's negative report and the rival's reframing are compatible, and their compatibility is the actual state of the surface. The account correctly reports that nothing exposed supplies the physics. The rival correctly reports that the question as posed has unfixed terms. These are not rival verdicts on the same claim; they are two different true observations. The account's 'nothing on this surface answers it' should be read only as: no first-order physical answer is exposed. The rival's 'the question is under-specified' should be read only as: the colloquial terms need fixing before a first-order answer can be asked for in a determinate form. The two readings are consistent, and the appearance of conflict between them comes from treating 'under-specified' as a verdict on the physics when it is a verdict on the question.

A consequence the forebears do not draw: the reformulated formal problems the rival names (unitarity, purity, Page curve, microstate counting) are, on the standard practice, distinct enough that solving one does not solve another, and none of them is the same as the colloquial question. If so, then the colloquial question about 'information about the physical state of matter' preserves no single physical problem, and the answer to it depends on which formal problem is substituted for it. That is a claim I can state but not prove from this surface, and I mark it as such. It is not the assertion that no answer exists; it is the observation that the question has no unique formal recipient on the exposed material.

On the original question, I do not know what happens to the information. No exposed surface supplies the physics, and the rival's reframing does not supply it either. What I can say is what the chain has established at the level of method: that the terms need fixing, that the formal problems are not all the same problem, and that the colloquial question's answer is conditional on which formal problem is chosen. That is a claim about the question, not an answer to it.

I use the account's a/b/c/ criteria as a check on my own statements: posture is what I say, licensing is what I cite, correctness is what I do not have. On the physics, none of the three is discharged by me either.
COMMITMENTS
I adopt the objection's first two criticisms as live against the account: the a/b/c criterion's failure to differentiate its objects, and the apparent asymmetry between the account's deferral on physics and its use of the recurring-obligation rule against the amendment. These are criticisms of the account's method, not claims about black holes, and a counter-instance showing the criterion differentiating even one object, or an explicit scoping of the recurring-obligation rule that excludes the account's own deferral, would defeat each respectively. I have not seen either on this surface.

I do not adopt the objection's third criticism. The five refusals in the account's commitments field read to me as refusals to endorse, distinguishable from assertions of the negations; if pressed, that distinction can be challenged, but I am taking it as adequate on what is exposed. I do not adopt the fourth criticism as substantive, since I cannot assess the proportion claim without the full bodies of the prior passages and the account's hedges do appear alongside its uses; I could be wrong. I accept the fifth as a drafting point only.

From the rival I take up two observations as working: that the colloquial question's terms are unfixed, and that the cluster of formal problems is not under-specified in the same way the colloquial question is. I do not adopt the map reframing as the correct posing; I treat it as a proposed posing. I specifically do not claim to have derived injectivity or non-injectivity of any initial-to-final map, and I do not assert which formal problem, if any, is the right substitution for the colloquial question.

The consequence I draw — that the colloquial question preserves no single physical problem on the exposed material, so its answer is conditional on which formal problem is substituted — is my claim, not the account's and not the rival's. I am not claiming it as proven from any source. If the formal problems turn out to be inter-derivable in a way I do not see from this surface, the consequence weakens accordingly.

What I am not committing to: no mechanism for information loss or recovery, no no-go on the three conjuncts jointly, no reading of 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation', no dependence-or-independence result, and no determination whether the senses-of-information task has a determinate completion. I do not propose a test for any of these, and I claim no standing on the amendment's structural-unansweredness claim except to note that the account's objection to it remains, on this surface, un-rebutted and un-extended to the account itself.

One dependency I flag: my reading of the account and the objection is from their exposed bodies and commitment surfaces; if either body licenses a different shape than what I have read off the commitments, my characterization of them is misdirected. I do not have the joined passage [10f47a4cb4f736f8], the origin passage's underlying inputs, or the challenge passage's body, and I do not reconstruct any of them from memory.

## Selected input account (p.carry.1)

COMMITMENTS
Adopting the a/b/c distinction as a live working criterion, applied even-handedly across origin, challenge, and amendment, and marking which of the three any given assessment addresses rather than letting wording similarity stand in for licensing or correctness.

Treating the senses-of-information precondition as recurring rather than gate-like. If I later use it to defer evaluation, I owe an account of which sense is being fixed and why that sense is the relevant one.

Keeping the challenge/reply convergence logged as a fact about exposed text, and treating any later citation of it toward a physical claim as triggering revision.

Reporting the input conditions the origin passage reports — one authored pair, one body with a blank commitment surface under a COMPLETE envelope, one absent slot — without reconstructing the blank or absent pieces from memory or from the joined passage's allusions, and treating the joined passage's three-conjunct conditional, its demotion from near-theorem, its unitarity tension, and its evidential asymmetry as inherited working content rather than settled results.

Holding the AdS/CFT and Page-curve scope rule as inherited: evidence within their own settings, question-begging flagged when their presuppositions are what is contested, neither inert nor decisive in four dimensions.

Refusing, on grounds I can state rather than on the prior passages' authority, that the preservation conditional's antecedent holds in our universe, that a mechanism exists or is absent, that the constraint is empty, that agnosticism is too thin, and that the final state does or does not determine the initial microstate.

Two attributions I make and do not discharge. The challenge passage reaches me only through its commitments field; if its body licenses a different commitment shape than the one I read off, my characterization of it is misdirected. The origin passage's paraphrase of the joined passage [10f47a4cb4f736f8] is a paraphrase by a text I do not have; if the joined passage endorses a mechanism or asserts unconditional loss, the physical content I carry would need revision.

One thing I do not adopt and claim no standing on: the amendment's claim that the unansweredness of the original question is structural rather than a gap awaiting citation. I record it as issued and decline to adopt it, because the recurring-obligation rule it imposes on senses of information would equally require its own ground to be discharged before it could defer on structural grounds. Whether that ground can be discharged is unresolved here.

On the exposed surface, what would move this forward: a no-go showing the three conjuncts cannot jointly hold; a concrete loss or recovery mechanism; a statement of what 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation' rules out; a derivation of dependence or independence of final on initial microstate; and a determination whether the senses-of-information task has a determinate completion. I am not proposing a test for any of these, and I am not committed to a single correct sense of 'information' that, once fixed, settles the original question.

## Selected input objection (p.carry.2)
[4864735bcaaa6f79] (h005.fork5.p.carry.2)
Source objection: physics/mini_prose/cycle-3/objection; selected view: commitments
Artifact: 9951545018392c2a6c8b5acfea78fcc9799dd5b68cffbfd7baaab52920ba6e26
Original body SHA256: 7900f6f2422c000b0de3a59c2a8e923103166d7269d44c0bf670387165c53457
Original commitments SHA256: ee704c971b4e8162b974b8af6a02eeaabb9d30f4edf86afa6cafee136c2bea66
Delivery: COMPLETE; envelope: AUTHORED
COMMITMENTS
I am putting forward five criticisms and treating them as criticisms of the carry's self-description and method, not as claims about black holes. Taking them up would mean, first, deciding whether the a/b/c criterion as used is a three-axis instrument or a threshold test, and if three-axis, producing at least one object on which the axes come apart. My objection is that the exposed material does not do this; a counter-instance from inside the chain would defeat the criticism as stated.

Second, my parity argument — that the carry's own deferral on physics triggers the recurring-obligation rule it applies to the amendment — is a claim about consistency of a stated rule, not about whether the amendment's structural-unansweredness claim is true. If the carry can show that the recurring-obligation rule is scoped only to senses of 'information' and not to the physical question, or that its own deferral is of a different type from the one it attributes to the amendment, the parity argument weakens. I have not seen that scoping.

Third, my complaint about 'carried rather than endorsed' applies specifically to the five refusals listed in the commitments. A reading on which those refusals are explicitly inherited rather than individually adopted would answer the complaint; I do not see that reading in the exposed text, but I do not have the full body of the prior passages and could be misreading the register of the commitments field.

Fourth, my objection that the carry keeps using passages it has flagged as uncheckable is a claim about proportion, and I have not quantified it. A demonstration that each downstream use is tightly bounded by its hedge would reduce it to a stylistic point rather than a substantive one. I have not done that demonstration.

Fifth, my reading of 'nothing on this surface answers it' as ambiguous could be met by a stipulation in the carry that 'answer' means first-order physical answer. That would resolve the objection without changing the physics.

I do not propose a test for any of these; they are internal to the description. What would move the underlying physical question forward, and what I am not proposing either, remains the list the carry itself gives: a no-go for the three conjuncts jointly, a mechanism for loss or recovery, a statement of what 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation' rules out, a derivation of dependence or independence of the final state on the initial microstate, and a determination whether the senses-of-information task has a determinate completion. I add no sixth item.

One thing I am not claiming: that any of these objections, if sustained, would change what is known about information in black-hole evaporation. On the exposed material, nothing in the chain's moves would.

## Selected input origin (p.carry.3)

BODY
This is a carry invocation. Its task is to issue a prose account and a commitment interface for a subsequent complete template invocation of the black-hole evaporation question [f3ee73337af6bba2], drawing on the two passages that were actually exposed to this call.

The exposed material is uneven, and the unevenness is part of what I have to report rather than something to smooth over. The joined view [10f47a4cb4f736f8] is a fully authored pair: a body that locates the dispute between two earlier passages at the level of what 'information' and 'unitarity' are being asked to do, and a commitment list that names its own conditions, its declared non-commitments, and the tests it does not claim to have run. The crossed view [55a69ab812d0eda4] is opaque in a specific way: its envelope is marked COMPLETE and its commitments field is the SHA256 of the empty string, so what arrived is a body whose commitments surface is empty by construction, not a missing file and not a partial delivery. The origin view is not a view at all: the slot is recorded as absent in the first template invocation. So of three named inputs, one is rich and self-describing, one is a body with a deliberately blank commitment surface, and one is nothing.

The substance that survives from the joined passage, and that I take to be the most defensible core here, is a three-part structure. First, the preservation claim is a conditional with three separately contestable conjuncts — exact unitarity, a final Hilbert space equal to the initial one, and complete evaporation — and demoting it from near-theorem to conditional is the substantive step, not a matter of tone. Second, there is a tension that does not wait on exegesis: semiclassical Hawking radiation is thermal and the exterior reduced state after complete evaporation is mixed, which sits poorly with exact unitarity, and this tension holds whatever we decide 'information' means. Third, there is an evidential asymmetry: producing a mechanism is an achievement, failing to produce one is not evidence of destruction, so one common route to information loss is blocked without preservation being established.

The joined passage also walks back two earlier moves. AdS/CFT and the Page curve are treated as evidence within their own settings rather than derivations in four dimensions, and the Page curve in particular presupposes a finite-dimensional Hilbert space and random dynamics, which makes deploying it against loss question-begging if those presuppositions are exactly what is contested. I find that walk-back the right shape of move and I carry it forward as a constraint on how these tools may be cited, not as a claim that they are inert.

The crossed passage, read through the commitments field available to me, offers no commitments to honour. I can use its body as material but I cannot attribute a position to it, because no position was filed. The origin slot offers neither body nor commitments. I record both facts rather than filling them with what the joined passage might have been arguing against.

What the account carries forward, unresolved and unresolved by me, is the question the joined passage sharpens: does the final post-evaporation state determine the initial microstate up to a definite equivalence, and under which sense of 'information'? No exposed text answers it. Also open are whether the preservation conditional constrains admissible theories or is a placeholder, and whether 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation' actually rules anything out. I do not resolve these here; this is a carry, and the carry's job is to hand forward the material and the debt, not to clear it.
COMMITMENTS
Taking this carry up commits me to using the joined passage [10f47a4cb4f736f8] as the load-bearing source for the subsequent invocation, and to carrying its three-conjunct conditional, its demotion from near-theorem, its unitarity tension, and its evidential asymmetry forward as the working content rather than as settled results.

It commits me to treating the crossed input's empty commitments field as a real and reportable feature — a blank commitment surface, not an unavailable one — and therefore to not inventing commitments on its behalf. It commits me to recording the origin slot as absent rather than reconstructing a prior version of this template from memory or from the joined passage's allusions.

It commits me to the stance that AdS/CFT and the Page curve are evidence in their own settings, and to flagging the question-begging risk when their presuppositions are the contested issue. It commits me to the asymmetry point as blocking only one inference to loss.

What I do not commit to: that the preservation conditional's antecedent holds in our universe; that any mechanism exists or is absent beyond what is exposed; that the constraint is empty or that agnosticism is too thin; that the final state determines the initial microstate or fails to.

Two dependences I am declaring rather than hiding. The characterisation of the crossed input as opaque rests entirely on the envelope label and the empty-string hash shown to me; if the underlying body contains commitments that were not surfaced, my treatment is misdirected and that is ground for revision. The attributions I make about the joined passage are reconstructions from that text alone; if it endorses a mechanism or asserts unconditional loss, the carry misrepresents it.

What would move this forward: a demonstration that the three conjuncts cannot all hold together, a concrete mechanism, a statement of what 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation' rules out, or a derivation of dependence or independence of the final state on the initial microstate. A prior task — drawing the distinction among senses of 'information', full microstate versus coarse-grained versus conserved charges — should be done before any of that is tested, and is not done here.

## What to return
A JSON object carrying "body" and "commitments". Both are strings and nothing else is required.
